## Whisper Large V3 API

Whisper Large V3 is a speech-to-text model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `openai/whisper-large-v3`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Whisper Large V3 is OpenAI's open-weight speech recognition model, trained on about 5 million hours of audio and able to transcribe around 100 languages. It's a robust general-purpose choice for multilingual transcription.

### Whisper Large V3 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openai/whisper-large-v3` | Standard | Private | $0.36 / audio hr |

### Whisper Large V3 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | OpenAI |
| Released | Jan 15, 2025 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |

### How to use the Whisper Large V3 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/transcriptions` with `"model": "openai/whisper-large-v3"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -F model=openai/whisper-large-v3 \
  -F file=@meeting.mp3
```
